summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, reporting first-quarter financial results and a business update. The filing states quarterly revenue of $8.5 million (up 8% YoY), operating loss of $1.8 million, and adjusted EBITDA loss of $1.2 million. There are no disclosed transaction terms, stake acquisitions, premiums, or board recommendations. The company outlines organic growth in its CDMO and D2C segments, with no special-situation event. Per the mapping of Canadian foreign private issuer filings, this constitutes a routine earnings release. What to watch: no risk-arb or event-driven catalyst, exclusively operational execution.
